vision: A fast, easy-to-use mobile shopping app where customers can find the right lighting for their home or project, from ceiling lights, chandeliers, pendants and wall lights to lamps, bulbs and smart lighting, by browsing, searching and filtering on lighting-specific details such as wattage, color temperature, dimmability and IP rating. They can then buy with confidence through a secure checkout and track their order through to delivery. Behind the app, our team manages products, inventory, promotions and orders from one admin area.
target_users: Homeowners and renters buying lighting for their own homes (new purchases, upgrades or replacements), including people who shop as guests without creating an account
Repeat customers who reorder bulbs or smart lighting, keep a wishlist, save shipping addresses and track past orders
Interior decorators, small contractors and renovation customers who need to compare specifications (wattage, lumens, voltage, IP rating, dimensions) across products
Admin/store staff (our own team) who add and edit products, manage inventory and prices, run promotions, and process, update, cancel and refund orders
Customer support staff who handle FAQs, contact requests and order-specific support
business_goals: Launch a working mobile shopping channel where customers can go from browsing to a paid order (P0 scope: registration/login, home, categories, search, product listing, filters, product details, variants, cart, checkout, payment, order creation, order history, inventory, admin product management, admin order management)
Increase sales by making it easy to find the right product through lighting-specific filters and structured specifications
Reduce lost sales and support load by preventing purchase of unavailable products and by showing accurate variant-level price, image, SKU and stock
Encourage repeat purchases and higher order values through wishlist, reviews, coupons (percentage, fixed amount, free shipping), discounted products and promotional push notifications (P1)

Build customer trust through secure payments, clear order statuses (Pending, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Delivered) and timely confirmation, payment, shipping, delivery and cancellation notifications
Understand customer behavior through basic analytics: product views, searches, add to cart, remove from cart, wishlist additions, checkout started, orders completed, revenue and cart abandonment
Give our team control over the catalog and orders without developer help
key_features: User Account: registration, login/logout, forgot/reset password, guest browsing, guest checkout, customer profile, manage shipping addresses
Home Screen: app logo/header, search bar, promotional banner, featured products, new arrivals, popular products, shop by category

Product Categories: Indoor Lighting, Outdoor Lighting, Ceiling Lights, Chandeliers, Pendant Lights, Wall Lights, Table/Floor Lamps, Bulbs, Smart Lighting, with category listing, subcategory navigation, product count and category images
Product Search: keyword search, search suggestions, recent searches, search results, no-results message
Product Listing: product image, name, price, sale price, discount, rating, stock status, add to wishlist, add to cart; sorting by Recommended, Price low to high, Price high to low, Newest, Best rated
Product Filters: price, brand, category, availability, color, wattage, color temperature, material, finish, dimmable, size
Product Details: images, name, SKU, brand, price, discount, description, specifications, availability, variants, quantity selector, add to cart, buy now, add to wishlist

Lighting Specifications (structured, where applicable): wattage, lumens, color temperature, voltage, light type, dimmable, material, finish, dimensions, weight, IP rating, bulb type, bulb included/not included
Product Variants: color, size, wattage, finish, color temperature; changing a variant updates the relevant price, image, SKU and availability
Wishlist (P1): add/remove products, view wishlist, move product to cart, display out-of-stock status
Shopping Cart: view items, change quantity, remove items, display variants, subtotal, apply coupon, calculate shipping, display taxes where applicable, order total, proceed to checkout
Checkout: customer information, shipping address, select/add address, shipping method, order summary, coupon/discount, payment method, place order
Payment: methods required by the business (credit/debit card, cash on delivery, bank transfer) with processing through a secure payment gateway
Order Management (customer): view orders, order details, status, purchased products, total amount, shipping information; statuses Pending, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Delivered
Order Confirmation: confirmation screen, order number, order summary, estimated delivery, confirmation email/push notification, Track Order option
Reviews & Ratings (P1): star rating, written review, only customers who purchased can review, average rating, review count
Notifications (P1): order confirmation, payment confirmation, order shipped, order delivered, order cancellation, promotional notifications
Customer Support (P1): FAQ, contact support, email/contact form, order-specific support
Admin Product Management: add, edit, activate/deactivate product, upload images, manage price, inventory, categories, brands, variants and lighting specifications
Admin Order Management: view, search orders, order details, update status, cancel orders, process refunds where applicable, view customer/shipping information
Inventory: stock quantity, out-of-stock status, low-stock status, prevent purchase when unavailable, variant-level inventory where applicable
Promotions: discounted products, coupon codes (P1), percentage discount, fixed amount discount, free shipping promotion
Basic Analytics (P1): product views, searches, add to cart, remove from cart, wishlist additions, checkout started, orders completed, revenue, cart abandonment
Security: HTTPS, secure authentication, password encryption/hashing, secure payment processing, API authorization, input validation, customer data protection, session management
Performance: fast app startup, lazy loading of product images, image optimization, pagination for product lists, cached frequently accessed data, proper error handling, loading indicators
constraints: MVP scope only: P0 features must be delivered first; P1 features (wishlist, reviews, push notifications, coupons, customer support, basic analytics) follow and must not delay P0
Payments must go through a secure payment gateway; the app must not store raw card details
Payment methods are limited to those the business requires: credit/debit card, cash on delivery, bank transfer
Order statuses follow one fixed flow for the MVP: Pending, Confirmed, Processing, Shipped, Delivered (cancellation and refunds handled by admin)
Variant changes must always update price, image, SKU and availability, and unavailable items cannot be purchased
Lighting specifications apply only to applicable products (for example, a bulb has different specs than a chandelier)
Only customers who purchased a product may review it
Security and performance requirements (HTTPS, hashed passwords, API authorization, input validation, pagination, image optimization, caching) are mandatory, not optional
Product lists must be paginated and images lazy-loaded so the app stays fast on average mobile connections
As the business owner I am not technical, so requirements are expressed in business terms and technical choices are left to the delivery team
open_questions: Which platforms must launch first: iOS, Android, or both? My working assumption is both, with the admin area as a web-based tool
Which payment gateway and which card brands do we use, and in which currency or currencies will we sell?
Which countries or regions will we ship to, and how will shipping be priced (flat rate, by weight/size, by region, free over a threshold)?
How are taxes handled (prices shown including or excluding tax, and which tax rates apply by region)?
Is cash on delivery available everywhere or only in certain areas, and is there a maximum order value for it?
How is bank transfer confirmed (manual check by staff or automatic), and how long do we hold an unpaid order before cancelling it?
What is the refund and return policy, and is a returns flow needed in the MVP or only admin-processed refunds?
When does stock get reserved: when an item is added to cart, when an order is placed, or when payment is confirmed? What threshold counts as low stock?
How many products, brands and variants will we launch with, and will the catalog be loaded in bulk (for example, from a spreadsheet) or entered manually?
Should customers be able to cancel an order themselves, and until which status?
Should guest checkout customers be able to track orders (for example, via email link), and should we prompt them to create an account after purchase?
Are social login options (Google, Apple) wanted, or is email and password enough for MVP?
What are the rules for coupons: one per order, combinable with sale prices, expiry dates, usage limits, minimum order value?
Who can use the admin area, and do we need different roles (for example, product manager, order staff, support) in the MVP?
Which languages does the app need at launch?
Do we need installation services, bulk or trade pricing for contractors, or product compatibility guidance (for example, bulb base type for a fixture)? Currently assumed out of MVP
What are the target launch date and budget, and which analytics tool should report the basic analytics?
How is customer support handled (email only, phone, live chat) and what are the service hours?
What are the data privacy and consent requirements for promotional notifications and analytics tracking in our markets?
